title: Policy Improvement-Guided Replay for Continual Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向持续强化学习的策略改进引导回放
abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. Our analysis links correct-response likelihood gains to reference-policy advantages under an idealized KL-regularized optimal update and provides an endogenous-reward interpretation for general policy updates. CoLiR estimates scores from finite training rollouts and cached log-likelihoods, selects prompts at task boundaries, and replays them uniformly during subsequent training, with KL regularization restricted to replayed prompts. Memory construction only requires a small amount of additional cross-policy scoring but no additional response generation. Across three Qwen3-VL model sizes on MRCL, CoLiR achieves the highest mean final accuracy and mean task accuracy among the compared methods while maintaining competitive new-task performance.
abstract_zh: 持续强化学习（CRL）要求模型在掌握新能力的同时维持旧任务表现。不同于侧重知识保留和减少任务干扰的传统视角，本文从策略改进出发，研究如何保住视觉语言模型在旧任务上已取得的性能增益。作者利用性能差异引理，将旧任务的性能变化与当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势联系起来，据此提出用当前策略回放历史提示。为分配有限的回放内存，作者提出 Contrastive Likelihood Replay（CoLiR），综合衡量从任务初始策略到最终策略时正确回答的似然增幅与错误回答的似然降幅。在理想化的 KL 正则最优更新下，正确回答的似然增益与相对于参考策略的优势相关；对一般策略更新，作者则给出内生奖励解释。CoLiR 利用有限的训练采样和缓存的对数似然评分，在任务边界筛选提示，并在后续训练中均匀回放，仅对回放提示施加 KL 正则。构建回放库只需少量额外的跨策略评分，无需额外生成回答。在 MRCL 上对三种规模的 Qwen3-VL 进行评估，CoLiR 在所比较方法中取得最高的平均最终准确率和平均任务准确率，同时保持有竞争力的新任务表现。
key_points_zh: 性能差异引理将旧任务表现的变化与当前策略在旧任务分布上的期望优势联系起来，为用当前策略回放历史提示提供依据。
CoLiR 对比任务初始与最终策略，按正确回答的似然上升和错误回答的似然下降筛选回放提示。
在理想化的 KL 正则最优更新下，正确回答的似然增益与参考策略的优势相关；对一般更新，作者给出内生奖励解释。
CoLiR 在任务边界利用已有训练采样和缓存评分选样，无需额外生成回答；后续均匀回放，仅对回放提示施加 KL 正则。
在 MRCL 的三种 Qwen3-VL 规模上，CoLiR 的平均最终准确率和平均任务准确率均领先所比较方法，新任务表现仍具竞争力。
